cases.name: IdentityFile 은 일치하는 모든 블록에서 누적되고 ~ 와 토큰이 확장된다
cases.text:
Host srv
  HostName 10.0.0.5
  User bob
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/a
  IdentityFile "%d/keys/%h-%r-%u-%p"
Host *
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/z
  IdentitiesOnly yes

cases.name: HostName 의 %h 토큰
cases.text:
Host app
  HostName %h.internal.example.com

cases.name: ProxyJump 체인과 user@host:port 형태, none
cases.text:
Host target
  ProxyJump j1, ops@j2:2201,[::1]:22
Host direct
  ProxyJump none
Host *
  ProxyJump ignored

cases.text:

  IdentityAgent none

cases.name: 따옴표 값·주석·행 끝 주석
cases.text:
# 주석
Host "my host"   # 끝 주석
  IdentityFile "C:\Users\me\my key"
  Port 2022 # 포트

cases.name: Match 블록은 적용하지 않고 Match all 만 전역으로 취급한다
cases.text:
Match host foo
  User matched
Host foo
  Port 1
Match all
  User all

cases.name: user@host:port 직접 입력은 설정의 user/port 보다 우선하되 host 설정은 조회한다
cases.text:
Host box
  HostName 1.2.3.4
  User cfg
  Port 9
  IdentityFile ~/k

cases.text:
Host * !x
  User all
Host alpha beta
  HostName 10.1.1.1
  Port 2200
  ProxyJump bastion
Host alpha
  User dup
Host bastion
  HostName b.example.com

cases.name: 지정한 known_hosts 파일들과 별칭을 돌려준다
cases.text:
Host box
  HostName 10.0.0.5
  UserKnownHostsFile ~/.ssh/kh1 ~/.ssh/kh2
  HostKeyAlias box-key
Host x
  UserKnownHostsFile none
Host y
  UserKnownHostsFile NONE ~/kh

cases.name: ProxyCommand 가 걸린 호스트는 unsupported
cases.text:
Host inner
  ProxyCommand ssh -W %h:%p bastion
Host none
  ProxyCommand none
Host NONE2
  ProxyCommand NONE
Host empty
  ProxyCommand ""
Host *
  ProxyCommand late

cases.name: 이 호스트에 걸릴 수 있는 Match 블록만 unsupported
cases.text:
Match host *.corp exec "true"
  IdentitiesOnly yes
Match user root
  User admin

resolved.unsupported: Match host *.corp exec true, Match user root
Match host *.corp exec true, Match user root

cases.name: 다른 호스트만 겨냥한 Match·옵션 없는 Match 는 영향 없음
cases.text:
Match host other
  User x
Match exec "true"
